cj_customer: Hey — reported an issue where applying a second promo seems to replace the first instead of stacking. Applied PROMO50 (50 credits) yesterday from the dashboard, then hit the API to apply STARTER10 and API returned 200 for both but balance only shows the STARTER10 amount. Org org_9f3. Any ideas?
marco_support: Sorry about that. Can you paste the request/response you used for the API call? Also which account/org id and the affected project?
cj_customer: Sure — project id proj-77, org org_9f3. Here's the curl I used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/apply 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"code":"STARTER10","scope":"org"}'
```
Response (200):
```json
{"success":true,"applied_code":"STARTER10","credits_added":10}
```
marco_support: Thanks. That looks fine — API accepted it so the endpoint path is correct. I'm going to pull the account ledger and promo table. tagging @jess_billing for possible promo policy nuance.
jess_billing: @marco_support quick note — we had a change last quarter: default behavior is last-applied promo supersedes previous promo for org-scoped coupons unless they are flagged as stackable in legacy_cases table. Could that explain it?
marco_support: Good catch. I'll check whether PROMO50 was marked stackable.
marco_support: Running quick queries: `SELECT code,stackable,applied_at FROM promo_ledger WHERE org_id='org_9f3' ORDER BY applied_at DESC LIMIT 10;`
(edited) result: `STARTER10 | false | 1958001200` then `PROMO50 | false | 1957910000` — both false for stackable.
olivia_engineer: FYI the API signal for apply doesn't currently return a field saying "overwrote_previous": true/false. We return success if code applied. That was intentional to keep API simple but it leads to confusion.
cj_customer: Hmm, that's surprising. The dashboard UI implied promos were additive when you have available credits. We thought credits would sum.
jess_billing: Dashboard messaging is ambiguous — apologies. Historically some legacy promos did stack but we moved to single-active-promo for org scope to prevent double-dipping. We should update UI copy.
marco_support: For remediation I can manually credit the missing 50 credits back to the project's balance and mark the ledger with a note. Would that work for you @cj_customer?
cj_customer: Yes please, that would help. Also would love a follow-up on whether the API will expose overwrite behavior so we can detect this programmatically.
jess_billing: I'll authorize a manual credit. @marco_support please create a billing adjustment: amount=50, reason="promo-stack-migration-rollback", external_ref=1958001234.
marco_support: Done — billed adjustment created: adj_885. Notified finance. Also added a ledger note: "manual restore 50 credits for org_9f3 per support thread 1958001234".
billing-bot: adjustment adj_885 queued for processing — ETA 24h.
marco_support: Marking customer satisfied? cc @olivia_engineer on API enhancement request to return a subtle flag when apply overwrote previous promo.
olivia_engineer: Thanks. Filing internal issue INF-1221: "promos: return meta on apply (stack/overwrite) + add dashboard clarity". I'll scope: add boolean in response `overwrote_existing` and add instrumented audit event.
jess_billing: Also adding a sane default in docs: "Org-scoped promo codes are not additive unless explicitly marked stackable. See promo flags." Will push docs update.
cj_customer: Appreciate the quick help. One small ask: can you confirm whether future promo applications via API will be prevented if they would overwrite (i.e., return 409) or still succeed with a flag?
olivia_engineer: For backwards compat we'll add the flag first (INF-1221). After rollout we can consider changing status codes — will follow up on compatibility.
marco_support: Closing loop: manual credit initiated, ledger updated, INF-1221 created, docs ticket created. If adj_885 posts successfully please ping in thread. :white_check_mark:
cj_customer: Thanks all! :raised_hands:
